errors.text_span: 在所有仇恨程度等级中，“无”刻板印象的频次均显著高于“有”刻板印象
errors.evidence: The generation prompt explicitly instructs to "avoid... comparison or drawing conclusions". This part of the description directly compares the values of the two categories ('无' and '有') and uses the evaluative term '显著高于' (significantly higher than), which is an interpretation of the data rather than an objective description of the visual elements.
